summary: Beamr Imaging Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, attaching a press release announcing integration of NVIDIA Video Super Resolution with Beamr's content-adaptive bitrate (CABR) encoding for live sports and broadcast video. The filing is routine business development news, not a special-situation transaction. No financial terms, ownership changes, or strategic actions are disclosed. The event focuses on product capability and a demonstration at IBC 2026. This does not meet any special-situations category.
